_comment: Daily strategy ranking settings — single source of truth for all ranking scripts. 9/22 user 收緊版 applied.

schedule._note: Single daily run at 00:00 HKT. Previous 3x (00:00/12:00/20:00 UTC) over-triggered LLM iteration and produced duplicated rankings. Use workflow_dispatch for manual re-rank.

sort_criteria._comment: 9/22 feedback: Total $ + PF 排行，R 只作附註
sort_criteria._r_note: Total R appears as a footnote column (rightmost), not in main sort. 種田要睇$同單筆風險，R係效率指標。

award_eligibility._detail: Strategy with n_trades < 10 is shown in the table but does NOT receive 🥇/🥈/🥉. Display with '  ' (no medal). Prevents n=2 B1 cases from taking silver due to lucky 1/1 WR.

ticker_split._detail: Add a Ticker column to the ranking table. Same ticker = consecutive rows (stable grouping, but global sort order is preserved across tickers). BTC口數扭曲 RSI/H ranking, 用拆欄後一目了然.

lookback._note: 20d for daily full-pipeline ranking, 7d for rolling (naturally derived from closed trades within window).

_history.v5.3_2026-10-07: Applied 9/22 收緊版: sort by Total $ + PF; n<10 no medal; ticker column.
_history.prior: Original settings: sort by PF → Total R → WR; no n<10 filter; no ticker column.
